Detailed Description

Templated concrete Column subclass representing columns with vector entries.

ColumnVectorData<T> has a data member of type std::vector<std::valarray<T> > of size HDU::rows() holding the data entries. It implements all numeric vector columns, as used in FITS Binary Tables.

The std::valarray implementation for the row entries provided array slicing and vectorized user supplied and intrinsic functions.
